metadata.name: Erosion
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A sunken temple court of mossy stone tiles over a pit of green acid. Every tile crumbles a second after you step on it and never comes back, and the rings fall away on their own from the outside in: the upper deck first, then the one below. Fall through a hole and the lower deck may catch you; the pads in the corner wells throw you back up while there is anything to land on. Only the sun stone in the middle never goes: you spawn on altars round the rim that throw you onto it. Deathmatch and Disc Arena rebuild the court every two and a half minutes; in Elimination it rebuilds every round.

do.text: Erosion: every tile you step on is gone. The rings fall from the outside in.
The outer ring falls in 3 seconds!
The lower outer ring falls in 3 seconds!
The next ring falls in 3 seconds!
The lower ring falls in 3 seconds!
The ring round the middle falls in 3 seconds!
The lower deck falls in 3 seconds!
